lines: Every person in this story is invented. Mandi and Jay are original models made for this game; the rest of the cast is built from CC0 MakeHuman parts.
The Kastell: Mog City's own black off-roader, with no maker's badges; a look-alike with no connection to any car maker.

card.role: model, Look 14, one shot at this

shots.line: Ring light on. Hair done. Laptop at the angle Bernie swears by. Okay, Chicago. Cast me.
And nobody calls. Not Jay. Especially not Jay. Tonight is about me.

card.role: runs the river's Duck Derby, from a riverboat

shots.line: Number seven is the favourite again tonight. He has never once won. Somebody always believes. Pour the champagne.

shots.sub: THE KASTELL. PARKED UNDER THE TRACKS. READY FOR NOTHING.

ramp.name: the ramp to the lower level

south-lot.name: the south end of the avenue

ohio.name: E Ohio St, north of the river

north-ave.name: Michigan Ave, north of the river

sheet.name: Mandi Reyes
sheet.role: hero: an aspiring model, still in her audition bikini
sheet.logline: Rescued her ex for years and swore she would quit. One more night.

posture.gestures: tucks her hair back, points with her keys

personality.speech: quick and wry, dead calm when she means it

voice.description: warm bright mezzo, quick and wry
a woman in her late twenties, a warm bright mezzo, quick and wry, dropping to dead calm when she means it; standard American delivery

speech.rhythm: short, quick, a joke and then the plan
speech.habit: "Okay." before she does the hard thing
speech.jokes: deadpan about her own outfit, never about anyone else's

sheet.name: Jay
sheet.role: Mandi's ex, who bets on everything
sheet.logline: Charming, lucky in nothing, forty thousand down on a rubber duck.

posture.gestures: rubs the back of his neck, grins when caught

personality.speech: fast when he is guilty, which is always

voice.description: easy sheepish tenor, fast when guilty
a man around thirty, an easy sheepish tenor, talking fast because he is guilty, which is always

speech.rhythm: apologies that turn into a bet halfway
speech.never: stays sorry for longer than a sentence

sheet.name: Diego Vale
sheet.role: boss of the river's Duck Derby, on his riverboat
sheet.logline: Dapper, theatrical, wants a leather brand of his own and a face to sell it.

posture.gestures: opens a hand like a showman, savours a pause

voice.description: smooth rich baritone, amused
a man in his fifties, a smooth rich baritone, courteous and amused, savouring every word; never shouts

speech.rhythm: long courteous sentences with a pause before the threat
speech.habit: calls her "the girl in the leopard"; "Regards."
speech.jokes: treats a duck race as grand opera

sheet.name: Kiki Moss
sheet.role: Mandi's best friend, a nail tech who livestreams everything
sheet.logline: Runs half of the city group chats from her salon chair.

personality.speech: fast, cuts in with "girl" and "hold on"

voice.description: fast bright alto
a young woman, a fast bright alto, cutting in with "girl" and "hold on, hold on"

sheet.name: Bernie Szabo
sheet.logline: Takes every call from his car; his signal always cuts out at the worst moment.

posture.gestures: mops his brow, waves the phone

personality.speech: gravelly and frantic, with a wheeze

voice.description: gravelly frantic older man
a man in his sixties, gravelly and frantic, a big-hearted wheeze

speech.rhythm: half a sentence, then the signal goes
speech.jokes: every no is basically a yes

sheet.name: Gloria Steele
sheet.role: Diego's accountant, quietly done with him
sheet.logline: Keeps the Derby ledger; every sentence a column of numbers.

posture.gestures: taps a pen against the ledger

voice.description: crisp low alto, precise
a woman in her forties, crisp and low, every sentence a column of numbers

sheet.name: Brick
sheet.role: Diego's huge, gentle enforcer, who knits
sheet.logline: Apologises before every shove; knits between jobs.

posture.gestures: holds his hands up to say sorry first

personality.speech: soft slow bass, polite to a fault

voice.description: soft slow bass, polite
a big man with a soft slow bass, polite to a fault

sheet.name: Simone Vance
sheet.logline: Bored, chic, and right about everything until the very end.

personality.speech: cool and clipped, a half-sigh in every note

voice.description: cool clipped alto with a sigh
a woman in her forties, cool and clipped, a half-sigh in every note

sheet.name: Deckhand Red
sheet.role: one of Diego's deckhands, who brawls and says nothing
sheet.logline: Red cap, red knuckles, no lines.

voice.description: grunts only
a big silent man; grunts only

sheet.name: Deckhand Blue
sheet.role: one of Diego's deckhands, who brawls and says nothing
sheet.logline: Blue cap, a whistle, no lines.

voice.description: grunts only
a stocky silent man; grunts only

missions.title: Out of Frame
missions.stakes: Forty thousand dollars on a rubber duck. Jay's kidnapped, and you're still in the bikini.
missions.passLine: Midnight. Forty thousand. And a man called Diego.

lines.line: Look Fourteen. Mandi. Good. Give me summer on the lake.
Summer on the lake. Okay.
She's a natural. Simone, she's a nat...
Lovely. Now give me the wind off the lake in November.
...Like this?
You shivered. Nobody shivers. Keep it.
...tural. Did I miss it? I missed it. She's a natural.
Now give me "you forgot your keys."
I have never once forgotten my keys.
That face. That's the face of a woman who forgot her keys. Yes.

slide.title: KIKI · 3 NEW MESSAGES
lines: Why is Jay on a BOAT.

lines.line: Sorry, that is not... my screen is sharing my texts.
Love the distraction. The glance at the phone. Keep it.
Mandi. Hey. Don't hang up. You're still on my calendar from when I used to help you prep.
Jay, I am in an audition. Why are you wearing a sign?
It says I owe Diego. Okay, so, technically, I'm kind of kidnapped.
Is he part of the look?
He is not part of the look.
Hello. Sorry. I joined from my own phone, it felt rude to lean into his.
Would you mind muting, ma'am? This is a family matter.
Of course.
Mr. Vale says tell her the number, Jay.
Forty thousand. On a duck. Number seven. He was so fast in practice.
A rubber duck, Jay?
Quackson. He's got a little racing stripe. Mandi, I think he's going to make me work it off forever, and the boat smells like...
We'll be in touch.
She said in touch! That's basically a... Mandi? Sweetheart? Can you hear me n...

shots.line: Okay. No time to change. Keys, phone, and his jacket. He's not getting it back either.

steps.text: MANDI'S REVENGE
steps.sub: I said I'd get you back.

steps.objective: Get to **Jay's lot** under the tracks

lines.text: Sweetheart! Simone said in touch. In touch is basically a yes. In this business that's a parade.
Bernie, Jay just got kidnapped on my audition.
On camera? Was it a good angle for you?
Bernie.
Sorry, sorry. Who has him?
Somebody called Diego. Jay owes him forty thousand dollars on a rubber duck.
Diego Vale. The Duck Derby. Oh, sweetheart, everybody on the river knows that guy. He's...
Bernie? You cut out at "he's."
...very theatrical. Wears a white suit in November. Don't sign anything he gives you.
Why would he give me anything to sign?
Everybody gives a pretty girl a contract. That's the whole city. Where are you going?
Jay's lot. Under the tracks. He leaves the car there when he's hiding from me.
In that outfit? It's November!
I've got the heater on full and a jacket on the passenger seat. I'm fine.

extra.text: You know what Simone told me after your first audition? 'She's got a face that waits for you.'
I don't know! I've been chewing on it for two years!
Put it on my card, Bernie.
Hold on, I'm double-parked and a man in a vest is writing me a poem.
It's got a rhyme scheme. Let me call you right... I'll call you righ...

wrap.text: I'm at the lot. His car's here. Bernie, I'll call you after.
Be careful, sweetheart. And smile with your eyes, in case.

pause.text: Go, go. I'll hold. I've been holding my whole career.

resume.text: You're back! What did I miss? Is he rescued?

steps.label: search Jay's car
steps.objective: Search Jay's red coupe.

steps.text: Girl. GIRL. His story has a boat, a sign, and a man in a white suit. Who is the white suit.
A betting slip. Duck Derby. Forty thousand, number seven, "Quackson." He signed it with a heart.

lines.line: Ah. The girl in the leopard. Jay said you would come for him. He bet on it, naturally.
What does he owe you? The real number.
Forty thousand on number seven. Seven came eleventh, of eleven. An honest race, and an honest debt.
I've got three hundred and twelve dollars and a ring light.
Then you have until midnight. Forty thousand, or Jay works it off. Forever is such a lovely word.
Mandi! He's got me polishing the duck trophies, there's like ninety of them...
He is muted. He is always muted. It is the only way to enjoy him.
And his car?
Collateral. A man will come by to collect it, and to keep you calm. Do let him.
I'm extremely calm.
Regards to the leopard.

steps.objective: Stay calm. Make him stay calm.

during.text: You're the man who keeps me calm? Great. Watch this.
These are slides. I am fighting you in slides.

steps.text: Okay. Forty thousand by midnight. Kiki will know somebody.

missions.title: Kiki's Chair
missions.stakes: You've got three hundred and twelve dollars. Diego's runners have the night's take.
missions.passLine: The van keys. And a very heavy duffel.

steps.text: WEST LOOP

steps.objective: Get to **Kiki's salon**

lines.line: Girl, you're live, say hi, eleven hundred people are watching you sit in a car in a bikini.
Kiki, turn it off.
Hold on, hold on, I'm turning it off. ...It's off. It's mostly off.
I need forty thousand dollars by midnight.
Okay. What have you got?
Three hundred and twelve.
So we're short thirty-nine thousand, six hundred and eighty-eight. I did your nails, I can do math.
I can do eight hundred! I can do eight hundred and a lunch.
Thank you, Bernie.
My cousin runs ducks for the Derby. Every race night the runners carry the take in a yellow van.
It just left the block. Yellow, loud, a duck on the roof. You can't miss it.
So I follow the duck van and take Diego's money to pay Diego.
Girl, that's not a crime, that's a refund.
I didn't hear that. My signal's very bad right n...

steps.name: the Derby van
steps.objective: Follow the yellow Derby van. Don't get spotted.

lines.text: Okay, I'm watching you on the map. Don't get close. Duck people are paranoid.
Why are they paranoid?
Because everybody wants the ducks! Hold on, hold on, my client's nail just popped off.
Kiki. Focus.
I'm focused. I can do a full set and a car chase. So what's the plan with Jay?
I get him off the boat.
And then?
And then I drop him off at his mother's and I go home.
Girl, you said that last time. And the time with the horse.
The horse was not my fault.
It was a little bit your fault. You gave it a carrot. It followed you for a mile.

extra.text: My comments are asking if you're cold.
Tell them I'm in a heated luxury vehicle.
The kind that gets my ex back.

wrap.text: It stopped! The warehouses. Go slow, go quiet, and don't lose a slide.

tooClose.text: Too close! Girl, you're on its bumper!
Back off, back off, they can see your headlights.

lost.text: Where did it go? I lost it on the map.
Left! I think it went left. Or right. Go!

steps.objective: Sneak through the lot to the van.

during.text: is now a bad time to say sorry
Yes, Jay. It is.

steps.objective: Get the van keys.

during.text: You again. How is your calm?
Keys. Thank you. You've been very professional.

steps.text: Got the keys. And a duffel the size of Bernie. Okay. Let's go.

missions.title: Lower Level
missions.stakes: Brick wants the van back. He's very polite about it.
missions.passLine: Ten o'clock. Forty thousand. And every single duck.

steps.text: THE WAREHOUSES

steps.name: Brick's black car
steps.objective: Lose Brick.

lines.text: Hello, Mandi. It's Brick. I'm the one behind you. In the black car. Sorry about this.
Are you calling me during a chase?
I didn't want you to think it was personal. Mr. Vale would like his van back.
Tell Mr. Vale to come and get it.
I am. That's this. That's what this is.
You took the corner very well. I wrote it down.
Are you knitting while you drive?
Only at the lights. It's a scarf. It's for my mother.

wrap.text: Oh. I've lost you. That's on me. Have a good night, Mandi.

steps.text: the deckhands' carts
steps.objective: Ram through the carts to the lower level.

shots.sub: RUBBER DUCKS. THOUSANDS OF THEM. NUMBERED. NO CASH.
shots.line: Ducks. It's all ducks. I stole a van full of ducks.

lines.line: You stole my ducks.
I stole your van. The ducks came with it.
Tonight's race needs those ducks. Without them it is just a river.
Mandi, they're numbered. He's going to know which ones are gone. He knows all their names.
I do. So. The deadline moves. Ten o'clock, not midnight. Forty thousand, and every duck.
Or what? You'll make him polish more brass?
Or he joins the race. Number forty-one. I have a very small life jacket.
He's not joking. He measured me.
Ten o'clock, leopard. Regards.

steps.text: Girl my cousin says the race is RIGGED. Every night. Says ask the accountant. Who has an accountant for ducks??

missions.title: Mirror Park
missions.stakes: An unknown number. "Meet me at the mirror. Come alone. Bring the ducks."
missions.passLine: Diego was the client. He picked her face.

steps.name: Unknown number
steps.text: Meet me at the mirror. Come alone. Bring the ducks.

steps.name: deadline
steps.label: DEADLINE
steps.why: Ten o'clock came and went. Diego added a duck to the race.

steps.objective: Get to **the mirror park**

during.text: Come alone, bring the ducks. Sure. Totally normal text.
If this is Jay's mother, I'm turning around.

lines.line: Gloria Steele. I keep Diego's books. We have four minutes before he wonders where I am.
You texted me from the bathroom?
The powder room. It has a lock and a mirror. That is all an accountant needs.
Number seven was built to lose. A lead keel. He's the favourite every week, and he sinks every week.
So Jay never had a chance.
Nobody does. That's the business.
...Velvet Lake. That's my audition.
Diego paid for it. He was the client. Camera off. He wants a face for his leather line, and he picked yours.
He set Jay up to get to me?
Jay was the cheapest way in. Forty thousand. Diego thinks you are worth a great deal more.
Why are you telling me?
Eleven years of his rounding. I'm done. My car's in the park. Get me out past his cart and I'll give you the ledger.

steps.name: Gloria's car
steps.objective: Get Gloria's car out past the cart.

during.text: Stay close. I drive the speed limit, to the decimal.
Cart on the right. Do not let him tap my door.
That's the harbor. I can breathe here.

steps.text: The ledger is yours when Jay is off that boat. I don't hand evidence to people who might lose.

missions.title: Pier Pressure
missions.stakes: A ten-year contract with the man who kidnapped Jay.
missions.passLine: Forty thousand views. One torn contract.

steps.text: THE PIER

steps.objective: Get to **the pier**

lines.text: Sweetheart. Sit down. Are you sitting? You're driving, you're sitting.
Bernie, what is it?
A client wants you exclusive. Ten years. It's huge. It's the biggest offer I've ever touched.
Who is the client?
Somebody called DV. Leather goods. Who is DV?
DV is the man who kidnapped Jay.
...So that's a no? That sounds like a no. Let me get the details, I'll put him on a call.
Put him on at the pier. I'll be there in two minutes.

wrap.text: I'm conferencing everyone. Simone too. Be gracious. Be... can you hear me n...

lines.line: Camera on, at last. I did so enjoy your audition. The November wind. The keys.
You were the client.
I am always the client. Ten years as the face of DV. The debt forgiven. Jay freed. Tonight.
It's a very good offer. I hate that it's a very good offer.
It's a great offer. Sweetheart, it's... is he a criminal? He seems like a criminal.
"Wardrobe: as auditioned."
The leopard sells, leopard. I only know what sells.

options.reply: Here's my signature. It comes in two pieces.
Signed. N-O-T, T-O-D-A-Y. Read it slowly.

lines.line: Ah. A no. I adore a no. It means we keep talking.
For the record, that was the best take of the night.
Brick is beside you, leopard. He will apologise first. He always does.
Tell him I accept.

steps.text: Sorry about this. I really am. Please hold my knitting.

steps.objective: Get past Brick.

during.text: Sorry. Sorry. That one was mostly the wind.
You are very hard to dislike.
Thank you. I'm trying a new stitch.

steps.text: Ow. Good. Mr. Vale is at the stadium lot, with the limo. Jay's washing it. I didn't tell you.
Girl I clipped the tear-up from your phone cam. 40K views. FORTY K. The comments want a name for the leopard

missions.title: Wrong Way Jay
missions.stakes: Brick says Jay's washing the limo at the stadium lot. Brick didn't tell you.
missions.passLine: Jay is in the car. The jacket is not his.

steps.text: THE LAKEFRONT

steps.name: Diego's white limo
steps.objective: Tail Diego's limo to the stadium lot.

during.text: A white limo in November. He wants to be seen.
Okay, Jay. Wash slowly. I'm coming.
Cousin says Jay is in a CHAUFFEUR CAP. A cap, girl. Bring your phone up.

steps.objective: Sneak past the deckhands to Jay.

during.text: Slides on asphalt. Very quiet. Very fashion.

shots.line: Mandi! You came! I knew you'd come. I had it at even money.

steps.name: Diego's deckhands
steps.objective: Lose the deckhands.

during.text: Is that my jacket?
No.
It is. That's my jacket, on the seat.
It's mine now.
Left! No, your left! Okay, both lefts were fine.
You drive like you're mad at me. ...Because you're mad at me.

lines.line: Is that him? Hold on, hold on. Jay. You owe me a full set.
Hi, Kiki. Hi, Bernie. Mandi. I mean it. I am really, truly, all the way sorry.
Okay.
And I learned something. About ducks. And about you. Mostly about you.
So, real quick. Can I bet on you? Tonight? I've got a really good feeling about you.
No.
No.
No!
...That's fair. That's a fair room.

missions.title: Double or Nothing
missions.stakes: The big race. Gloria's ledger, Kiki's stream, and nine hundred and eighty sevens.
missions.passLine: A thousand sevens won. The house lost.

steps.text: THE BIG DERBY

lines.line: Jay is off the boat. The ledger is yours. Here is what it proves.

slide.title: TONIGHT · THE BIG DERBY
lines: Every bettor in the city on number seven

lines.line: And I stream the race. Live. With the ledger on screen. Forty thousand people already follow the leopard.
So everybody sees it's rigged while it's rigged.
What if seven wins, though?
Seven cannot win. Seven has a keel.
One seven can't. But we've got a van full of ducks. How many sevens?
...Nine hundred and eighty. Every spare seven he owns.
Jay. That is the first good bet you have ever made.
I have a system.
I'm in! What am I in?
Kiki, you're in the minivan. I'm behind you to the riverwalk. Then the ducks go in upstream.

steps.name: Kiki's minivan
steps.objective: Stay behind Kiki's minivan to the riverwalk.

during.text: The rig is on the roof. Do not let anyone tap me, girl, that rig was a birthday present.
She's going thirty-one in a thirty. That's wild.
Riverwalk! I'm setting up. Go drop the ducks!

steps.name: race
steps.label: RACE
steps.why: The race started without the sevens. Seven sank, the house won.

steps.objective: Get the ducks **upstream** before the race starts

during.text: Upstream. Okay. Which way is upstream? Rivers don't have signs.
This river runs backwards, Jay. Trust me.

steps.label: tip the ducks in
steps.objective: Tip the ducks into the river.

shots.sub: NINE HUNDRED AND EIGHTY NUMBER SEVENS FLOAT PAST THE FINISH.
KIKI'S STREAM: THE LEDGER, LIVE. THE BETTORS' PHONES LIGHT UP.

lines.text: Forty-one thousand watching. Hold on, hold on, the comments just found out about the keel.
And Diego?
Diego just found out about the comments.

steps.objective: Hold the riverbank.

during.text: I'll hold your jacket!
You will not hold my jacket.
Behind you! The red one! The other red one!

steps.text: Girl. The sevens won. A thousand sevens won. The bettors are swimming after them.

missions.title: Bridge Up
missions.stakes: Diego is leaving with the cash. The bridges go up at eleven.
missions.passLine: I said I'd get you back. I never said I'd take you back.

steps.text: THE RIVER BRIDGES

lines.line: Brava. Truly. A thousand sevens. I could not have staged it better.
You're running.
I'm relocating, with the night's take, which is still technically mine. The bridges go up at eleven for the boats.
By the time they come down, I am a rumour. Regards to the leopard.
Jay. Seatbelt.

do.text: The bells. Those are the bridge bells.
Mandi. Mandi, the bridge is going up. The bridge is going up!

steps.name: Diego's white limo
steps.objective: Catch the limo before the bridge.

during.text: He's got a tiny flag on the hood. That's how you know he's evil.
Hold on to something.
I'm holding the sponge!

steps.objective: Pull up on the limo.

steps.text: Leopard. I have never thrown a punch. I would like you to know I am about to.

steps.objective: Settle up with Diego.

during.text: Was that one? Did I throw one?
That was a wave, Diego.
My loafers! These are Italian!

steps.text: Forty thousand, Diego. Jay's debt. Paid in full, in ducks.
He fell in. He fell in the river with all the sevens. He's fine, he's floating. Everything in there floats.

people.label: Gloria
people.sub: a train out of town · the ledger

lines.line: The new client watched Kiki's stream. All of it. You're the face. In the leopard.
...I got it?
You got it. Try to forget your keys more often.
Can you hear me? Can you hear me? I can hear me! Sweetheart, you're the face!
I'm crying. My signal works and I'm crying.
GIRL!
The ledger is with the river police. I rounded nothing.
So... are we back?
I said I'd get you back. I never said I'd take you back.
Can I at least have the jacket?
No.

steps.title: MANDI'S REVENGE
story: She walks the riverwalk at dawn, in the leopard and the slides, with Jay's jacket over her arm.

meta.title: Mandi's Revenge
meta.tagline: I said I'd get you back. I never said I'd take you back.
meta.blurb: Mandi Reyes is one callback from her big break when her ex, Jay, goes missing over a gambling debt to a Chicago crime boss. In a leopard bikini and fuzzy slides, she takes the wheel of her black Kastell for eight missions across the Loop, the river and the lakefront, every call on her foldable phone.

storykit.credit: Every person and company in this story is invented. The black off-roader is adapted from a model by DemuriaGT (Sketchfab), CC BY 4.0, modified, with no maker's badges.
